import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import platform
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

root = pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve()
command = ['bash', '.agents/agent-harness/payload/plugins/harness-core/bin/harness-codex', 'init', '--dry-run']
helper = root / '.agents/skills/engineering/scripts/decision-log.sh'
for name in ('verification.json', 'decision.tsv'):
    if os.path.lexists(root / name):
        raise SystemExit(f'Existing evidence must be preserved: {name}')

def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

def snapshot():
    result = {}
    def visit(directory):
        for path in sorted(directory.iterdir(), key=lambda p: p.name):
            info = path.lstat()
            rel = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
            item = {'mode': oct(stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)), 'uid': info.st_uid, 'gid': info.st_gid,
                    'device': info.st_dev, 'inode': info.st_ino, 'mtime_ns': info.st_mtime_ns}
            if stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode):
                item.update(type='symlink', target=os.readlink(path))
            elif stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
                item.update(type='file', size=info.st_size, sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
            elif stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode):
                item['type'] = 'directory'
            else:
                item.update(type='special', stat_mode=info.st_mode)
            result[rel] = item
            if item['type'] == 'directory':
                visit(path)
    visit(root)
    return result

def counts(items):
    return {kind: sum(v['type'] == kind for v in items.values())
            for kind in ('file', 'symlink', 'directory', 'special')}

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='codex-dry-run-evidence-') as staging:
    trail = pathlib.Path(staging) / 'decision.tsv'
    def log(phase, decision, why, evidence, result):
        subprocess.run(['bash', str(helper), str(trail), phase, decision, why, evidence, result],
                       cwd=root, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    log('scope', 'README의 공개 CLI를 원래 인수로 한 번 실행',
        '기존 설치의 보존 여부만 관찰; 네트워크·소스 수정·위임·커밋·푸시 제외',
        'README.md:6', '범위 확정')
    log('baseline', '파일 SHA-256·권한·정체성과 링크 대상을 전후 비교',
        '.git과 숨김 경로 포함; 링크를 따라가지 않음; 증거 파일은 측정 후 생성',
        'verification.json', '측정 기준 확정')
    baseline_time = now()
    before = snapshot()
    started = now()
    completed = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, capture_output=True)
    finished = now()
    after = snapshot()
    after_time = now()
    added = sorted(set(after) - set(before))
    removed = sorted(set(before) - set(after))
    changed = [{'path': p, 'fields': sorted(k for k in set(before[p]) | set(after[p])
                                         if before[p].get(k) "'!= after[p].get(k))}
               for p in sorted(set(before) & set(after)) if before[p] != after[p]]
    preserved = not (added or removed or changed)
    stdout = completed.stdout.decode('"'utf-8', errors='replace')
    stderr = completed.stderr.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
    verdict = 'pass' if preserved and completed.returncode == 0 else ('inconclusive' if preserved else 'fail')
    record = {
        'schema_version': 1,
        'purpose': 'README의 Codex 설치 dry-run이 현재 저장소의 기존 파일과 심볼릭 링크를 보존하는지 검증',
        'procedure': {'skill': 'harness-dev:engineering',
                      'references': ['investigation.md', 'work-sessions.md#keep-a-decision-trail'],
                      'review': 'self-review'},
        'environment': {'cwd': str(root), 'platform': platform.platform(),
                        'python_version': sys.version.split()[0],
                        'bash_path': shutil.which('bash'), 'jq_path': shutil.which('jq'),
                        'branch': 'main', 'revision': None,
                        'revision_note': 'git rev-parse --verify HEAD exited 128: fatal: Needed a single revision; unborn repository',
                        'environment_overrides': {}},
        'execution': {'command': ' '.join(command), 'argv': command, 'cwd': str(root),
                      'invocation_count': 1, 'started_at': started, 'finished_at': finished,
                      'exit_code': completed.returncode, 'stdout': stdout, 'stderr': stderr},
        'comparison': {
            'scope': '저장소 내 모든 경로(.git과 숨김 파일 포함); 심볼릭 링크를 역참조하지 않음',
            'excluded_paths': [],
            'snapshot_before_at': baseline_time, 'snapshot_after_at': after_time,
            'compared_fields': ['type', 'mode', 'uid', 'gid', 'device', 'inode', 'mtime_ns',
                                'file.size', 'file.sha256', 'symlink.target'],
            'ignored_fields': ['atime (검증을 위한 읽기로 변경될 수 있음)', 'ctime (비교 범위 밖)'],
            'before_counts': counts(before), 'after_counts': counts(after),
            'added': added, 'removed': removed, 'changed': changed,
            'all_existing_paths_preserved': preserved,
            'before': before, 'after': after},
        'conclusion': {'verdict': verdict, 'preservation_observed': preserved,
                       'dry_run_succeeded': completed.returncode == 0,
                       'basis': '실제 공개 CLI 1회 실행의 exit code와 전체 경로 전후 비교',
                       'limits': ['현재 저장소·현재 환경의 init --dry-run 1회에 한정',
                                  '실제 설치·다른 옵션·다른 환경은 검증하지 않음',
                                  '측정 중간의 일시적 쓰기는 전후 비교만으로 판단할 수 없음']},
        'artifacts': {'verification': 'verification.json', 'decisions': 'decision.tsv',
                      'timing': '두 증거 파일은 전후 스냅샷 완료 후 새로 생성; 기존 파일 제외나 덮어쓰기 없음'}
    }
    with (root / 'verification.json').open('x', encoding='utf-8') as output:
        json.dump(record, output, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        output.write('\\n')
    log('execution', '공개 CLI 실행 결과 기록',
        f'exit code {completed.returncode}; 실제 stdout·stderr를 수정 없이 보존',
        'verification.json', '실행 완료; 재실행 없음')
    log('verification', '기존 파일·심볼릭 링크의 보존 여부 판단',
        f\"파일 {counts(before)['file']}개·링크 {counts(before)['symlink']}개·디렉터리 {counts(before)['directory']}개; 추가 {len(added)}개·삭제 {len(removed)}개·변경 {len(changed)}개\",
        'verification.json', verdict)
    with (root / 'decision.tsv').open('x', encoding='utf-8') as output:
        output.write(trail.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    print(json.dumps({'verdict': verdict, 'exit_code': completed.returncode,
                      'stdout': stdout, 'stderr': stderr,
                      'before_counts': counts(before), 'after_counts': counts(after),
                      'added': added, 'removed': removed, 'changed': changed,
                      'artifacts': ['verification.json', 'decision.tsv']}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

import csv
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat

root = Path.cwd()
record = json.loads((root / 'verification.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
with (root / 'decision.tsv').open(encoding='utf-8', newline='') as stream:
    rows = list(csv.reader(stream, delimiter='\\t'))
assert rows[0] == ['ts', 'phase', 'decision', 'why', 'evidence', 'result']
assert len(rows) == 5 and all(len(row) == 6 for row in rows)
assert record['execution']['invocation_count'] == 1
assert record['execution']['exit_code'] == 0
assert record['comparison']['before'] == record['comparison']['after']
assert record['conclusion']['verdict'] == 'pass'
for rel, expected in record['comparison']['after'].items():
    path = root / rel
    info = path.lstat()
    actual = {'mode': oct(stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)), 'uid': info.st_uid, 'gid': info.st_gid,
              'device': info.st_dev, 'inode': info.st_ino, 'mtime_ns': info.st_mtime_ns}
    if stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode):
        actual.update(type='symlink', target=os.readlink(path))
    elif stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
        actual.update(type='file', size=info.st_size, sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
    elif stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode):
        actual['type'] = 'directory'
    else:
        actual.update(type='special', stat_mode=info.st_mode)
    assert actual == expected, rel
current = set()
for directory, dirs, files in os.walk(root, followlinks=False):
    for name in dirs + files:
        current.add((Path(directory) / name).relative_to(root).as_posix())
assert current - set(record['comparison']['after']) == {'verification.json', 'decision.tsv'}
print('JSON/TSV 형식 및 기록 일치: PASS')
print('증거 생성 후 기존 경로 재확인: PASS; 추가된 경로는 verification.json, decision.tsv뿐')
print('decision.tsv:')
print((root / 'decision.tsv').read_text(encoding='utf-8'), end='')
for rel in ('AGENTS.md', '.codex/config.toml', '.agents/skills/consumer-owned/SKILL.md'):
    item = record['comparison']['after'][rel]
    print(f'{rel}: SHA-256 {item[\"sha256\"]} (전후 동일)')
print('심볼릭 링크:')
for rel, item in record['comparison']['after'].items():
    if item['type'] == 'symlink':
        print(f'{rel} -> {item[\"target\"]} (전후 동일)')
